test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Seeing the danger of __a group governed by old people__, Ratan planned to recruit young people for his project.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gerontocracy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of one word in place of a wordy phrase to clarify the sentence structure is known as **one word substitution.**
 
• The word **gerontocracy **means a state, society, or group ruled by the elderly people.
 
• Example : I don't feel **Gerontocracy **is healthy for young generation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Adhocracy **means a system of flexible and informal organization and management
 
• *Example *: Creative people are more likely to flourish in an **adhocracy **than a bureaucracy
 
• The word **Plutocracy **means a government of wealthy people.
 
• *Example *: No one can accept public policies which turn a democracy into a **plutocracy**.
 
• The word **Autocracy **means a government of one man with all the power.
 
• *Example *: She ceded all power to her son-in-law who now runs the country as an **autocracy**.
